title: Packers S Xavier McKinney: I see what's going on with officiating and it's killing us

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Packers S Xavier McKinney: I see what's going on with officiating and it's killing us
sources.description: Packers head coach Matt LaFleur got heated with officials several times during Sunday's 20-17 loss to the Lions, but he didn't want to make them the focus of his postgame comments.
